en.title: Accessibility News Daily Digest - April 27, 2026
en.summary: Three key accessibility developments emerge today: The Through the Student Lens festival is showcasing various films while enhancing accessibility features for viewers with disabilities, promoting inclusive cinema. In cultural news, a theatre company has created an accessible performance specifically designed for individuals with autism and intellectual disabilities, providing an inclusive cultural experience. Meanwhile, The Irish Times examines Ireland's Basic Income for the Arts scheme and whether it adequately supports artists with disabilities, exploring potential barriers to participation.

highlights.title: Through the Student Lens festival presents assorted work, boosts film accessibility
Theatre company creates accessible show for people with autism, intellectual disabilities
Basic Income for the Arts: how accessible is it for artists with disabilities? - The Irish Times

zh-TW.title: 無障礙新聞每日摘要 - 2026年4月27日
zh-TW.summary: 今日出現三項重要的無障礙發展：「透過學生鏡頭」電影節正在展示各種電影，同時為殘障觀眾增強無障礙功能，促進包容性電影。在文化新聞方面，一個劇團專門為自閉症和智障人士創作了無障礙表演，提供包容性的文化體驗。同時，愛爾蘭時報探討愛爾蘭藝術基本收入計劃是否充分支持殘疾藝術家，並探索潛在的參與障礙。

highlights.title: 「透過學生鏡頭」電影節呈現多樣作品並提升電影無障礙
劇團為自閉症和智障人士製作無障礙演出
藝術基本收入：對殘疾藝術家來說是否無障礙？- The Irish Times
